subject: E-Commerce
title: Napkin Sketch: The Flywheel
description: One-minute skill: Napkin Sketch: The Flywheel.

hook.text: Amazon's entire strategy was once drawn on a napkin. It showed a circle where each part fueled the next.

buildup.text: Lower prices attract more customers. More customers attract more sellers. More sellers lower prices more.

discovery.text: Each spin of the flywheel adds momentum. Growth funds infrastructure, which reduces costs, which grows more.

twist.text: The flywheel is why Amazon enters markets below cost. Losses today spin the wheel faster for tomorrow.

climax.text: The napkin sketch became the most studied strategy in business. Simple concept, relentless execution.

punchline.text: One napkin sketch, one virtuous circle. It powered a $1.5 trillion company.

quiz.question: What does Amazon's flywheel concept describe?
options: A self-reinforcing growth loop where each part fuels the next
